_description: Valid state transitions for Collection and CollectionShare. Any transition not listed is invalid and MUST be rejected. Terminal states accept no further transitions.

rules.OPEN: Shares may be created/surfaced and paid.
rules.PARTIALLY_COMPLETED: Entered when at least one share is PAID but not all (closed rules) / target not reached (open rules).
rules.COMPLETED: All shares PAID (closed rules) or target reached (open rules). Terminal.
rules.immutability: After OPEN: currency, rule, and (closed-rule) total_amount_minor are immutable (INV-COLLECTION-007).

rules.LINK_CREATED: A PaymentIntent (ADR-015) exists; its link/QR is presentable.
rules.PAID: Reached ONLY on a real confirmed Transfer; transfer_id set; Transfer.causation_id == payment_intent_id (INV-COLLECTION-005). Terminal — no double payment (INV-COLLECTION-006).
